title: specy-road READY hand-off
description: YAML front matter of work/reviews/<NODE_ID>/READY-<agent>.md: an executor's statement that its implementation is committed and ready for review.

agent.description: Executor model id (roster id when rostered).

commit.description: Implementation commit the executor stopped at.

changed_paths.description: Every path the executor changed, repo-relative.

verify.description: Verifier and test commands the executor ran, with exit status and the tail of their output.
